title: Robinson Helicopter Company
goal: To enhance pilot experience by integrating the Lightspeed ANR Zulu 4 headset into its offerings.
abstract: Robinson Helicopter Company has integrated the Lightspeed ANR Zulu 4 headset for enhanced safety and clarity in helicopter operations. Starting late November, customers can order or add this high-quality option at $1,099 USD. The Zulu 4 features advanced noise reduction and audio clarity technology.
capability: Enhanced safety and clarity for pilots through improved noise reduction and audio quality.
